item.title: Frequency Spreading
item.description: One of the most infuriating things about modern PCs, barring RGB, is the tonal noise of fans. That continually amplified jet engine sound while you're trying to think. It's been my mission for a while to free myself from this. I think I've finally found a workable solution, or rather taken one from the 2019 Mac Pro 7,1. That is frequency spreading, which in Apple's case is asymmetric blade spacing (sometimes called blade randomization). The fan blades are physically distributed a...
